title: Friday 260807
wodRaw:
**Community Cup Workout 1**

For time:  
1,000-meter row

Then,

5 rounds of:  
25 pull-ups  
7 shoulder-to-overheads

♀ 85-lb barbell  
♂ 135-lb barbell

Compare to [200925](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2020/09/25).

Post time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Welcome to the first workout of the 2026 Community Cup! This workout comes from the 2007 CrossFit Games and is a hopper-style workout, meaning the movements were pulled at random to create a workout at the first Games. If you're signed up for the Community Cup, perform the variation for your level. If not, scale to fit your needs and capacity.

The row at the start is a trap — find a pace that lets you get off the rower and go straight into the 5 rounds. We're not adjusting the row distance for women, since it wasn't adjusted in 2007; to maintain the workout's integrity, men and women complete the same distance. All athletes should be off the rower in under 6 minutes.

This is a pull-up workout with 125 total reps in the Rx'd version, so strategy matters. Complete each set of 25 reps in 5 sets or fewer, with no singles and no sets under 3 reps — think 15/10, 10/8/7, 8/7/5/5, or 5/5/5/5/5 if needed.

For the push jerks, loading is on the lighter end of moderate — every round should be unbroken. If you think you could hit 10 reps before breaking, the weight is right; if you think you could hit 15, it's too light.

If you're signed up for the Community Cup, don't forget to log your scores.

**Intermediate option:**  
For time:  
1,000-meter row  

Then,

5 rounds of:  
**15** pull-ups  
7 shoulder-to-overheads

♀ **65**-lb barbell  
♂ **95**-lb barbell

**Beginner option:**  
For time:  
1,000-meter row

Then, 

5 rounds of:  
**10 ring rows**  
7 shoulder-to-overheads

♀ **35**-lb barbell  
♂ **45**-lb barbell

title: Saturday 260808
wodRaw:
5 rounds for time of:  
30 medicine-ball cleans  
20 ring dips

♀ 14-lb medicine ball  
♂ 20-lb medicine ball

Post time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
This workout combines two movements that each pack a punch in very different ways. Expect the med-ball cleans to fatigue the lower body much quicker than you'd expect. Set a goal to move quickly through large chunks of reps before needing to take breaks. The ring dip volume is very high and will be the most difficult part of the workout for most. This movement will significantly tax the chest, shoulders, and triceps. If you're not able to perform 10-15 reps consecutively, plan to scale the reps or difficulty. Due to the volume of this workout, start conservatively, particularly for the ring dips. Do a small number of reps at a time, staying well short of muscular failure.

**Intermediate option:**

title: Monday 260810
wodRaw:
5 rounds, each for time, of:  
15 box jump-overs  
12 dumbbell deadlifts  
9 dumbbell hang power cleans  
6 dumbbell shoulder-to-overheads

Rest exactly 2 minutes between rounds.

♀ 35-lb dumbbells and a 20-inch box  
♂ 50-lb dumbbells and a 24-inch box

Post time for each round to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
This twist on the Hero workout DT swaps in dumbbells and adds a spicy box jump-over, with rest after each set. Rounds will likely move faster than the barbell version since dumbbells are easier to hang onto. Use the rest to push each round like a sprint. Finish the box jump-overs, grab the dumbbells, and hang on!
Keep deadlifts unbroken through all rounds. If needed, break the hang power cleans and shoulder-to-overheads into 2 sets, keeping rest breaks to 15 seconds or less — scale to maintain this. Reduce dumbbell load if needed to keep a flat back and sound shoulder position through the deadlifts and jerks.
Advanced athletes: Aim for as many rounds as possible without putting the dumbbells down before moving up to a heavier load.

**Intermediate option:**

title: Tuesday 260811
wodRaw:

Compare to [250923](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2025/09/23).

Post time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today's workout looks intimidating and may seem like a daunting task. Looking at it as a whole, 5,000 meters seems like a lot, but try viewing it through a different lens: break the work into 500- to 1,000-meter chunks to make it manageable. Focus on keeping your split time (per 500-meter pace) consistent. Start with an easier pace, then speed up once you gain confidence, or hold one steady pace through the entire piece — both are great strategies.
If you've done a 5,000-meter row before, use this as a chance to revisit that attempt and find where you can improve. Today is an opportunity to PR. Remember to sit up tall on the rower, breathe, and think positive thoughts.

Same as Rx'd.

title: Friday 260814
wodRaw:
**Community Cup Workout 2**

The CrossFit Total

1-rep-max back squat  
1-rep-max press  
1-rep-max deadlift

Compare to [220810](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2022/08/10).

Post loads to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Welcome to the second workout of the 2026 Community Cup — a throwback to the 2007 CrossFit Games. If you're signed up for the Community Cup, perform the variation for your level. Remember, this year you can choose to compete in a level above your own. If you're not signed up, scale the workout to fit your needs and capacity.

Today is benchmark heavy day: a heavy 1-rep back squat, shoulder press, and deadlift.

If you're signed up for the Community Cup, pay attention to the competition format. At "3, 2, 1 … go," you'll have up to three attempts to establish your 1-rep-max squat, resting as much as needed between attempts. You cannot take more than three attempts, and you're not required to take all three. Then establish a 1-rep-max press, followed by a 1-rep-max deadlift, using the same format.

If you're not signed up, take as much time as you need to find your heavy lifts. Start with a couple of 3- to 5-rep sets in each lift before moving to singles and finding your max for the day. Aim for the heaviest lift possible in each movement today — around 85% or more of your 1-rep-max. Plan strategic jumps in load to optimize your effort and preserve energy for all three lifts.

If you're signed up for the Community Cup, don't forget to log your scores.

**Intermediate option:**    
Same as Rx'd.

**Beginner option:**   
Same as Rx'd.

title: Saturday 260815
wodRaw:
**LGOP (Little Groups of Paratroopers)**

In teams of 2-4, 2 rounds for time of:  
1,940-meter run (together)  
250 air squats (split reps)  
48 burpees (split reps)  
509-meter run with one plate (together, share the plate)  
101 push presses (split reps)  
11 pull-ups (each athlete)  
82 power cleans (split reps) 

♀ 75-lb barbell and a 35-lb plate  
♂ 115-lb barbell and a 45-lb plate

Post time to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Today, we have a fun partner/team workout to honor our nation's paratroopers. Learn more about the 82nd Airborne Association. As soon as you start to slow down, switch out and let someone else go to work. Each piece of this workout has significance to the U.S. Army airborne forces:

1940 is the date of the birth of the U.S. Army airborne forces.  
48 is the number of original parachute test platoon volunteers.  
250 is for the 250-foot jump towers.  
509 is for the 509th Parachute Infantry Battalion.  
101 is symbolic of the 101st Airborne Division.  
11 is symbolic of the 11th Airborne Division.  
82 is symbolic of the 82nd Airborne Division.  

Grab a few friends and get after it!

**Intermediate option:**  
In teams of 2-4, 2 rounds for time of:  
1,940-meter run (together)

48 burpees (split reps)

101 push presses (split reps)  
11 pull-ups (each athlete)  
82 power cleans (split reps)

♀ **65**-lb barbell and a **25**-lb plate  
♂ **95**-lb barbell and a **35**-lb plate

**Beginner option:**

title: Monday 260831
wodRaw:
**Fight Gone Bad**

3 rounds for max reps of:  
1 minute of wall-ball shots  
1 minute of sumo deadlift high pulls  
1 minute of box jumps  
1 minute of push presses  
1 minute of rowing for calories  
Rest 1 minute

♀ 55-lb barbell, 14-lb medicine ball to a 9-foot target, and a 20-inch box  
♂ 75-lb barbell, 20-lb medicine ball to a 10-foot target, and a 20-inch box

Compare to [250503](http://www.crossfit.com/workout/2025/05/03).

Post reps to comments.

**Stimulus and Strategy:**  
Fight Gone Bad is a classic CrossFit benchmark that targets metabolic conditioning and stamina. The goal is to stay in constant motion while avoiding full muscular fatigue in any one movement.

Before you start, pull up your score from May 3, 2025, so you have a clear target to beat. Hold full range of motion on every movement throughout. On the rower, keep moving continuously but only push as hard as you can without dragging down your other reps — it's already your lowest-rep station, so it's not worth it to go too hard there. Pick one movement you're strongest at and go all-out on it for your highest score, holding moderate, steady reps. You'll rack up the biggest total by leaning hard into push presses and wall-ball shots while easing off on sumo deadlift high pulls and rowing.

**Intermediate option:**  
Same as Rx'd.

**Beginner option:**   
3 rounds for max reps of:  
1 minute of wall-ball shots  
1 minute of sumo deadlift high pulls  
1 minute of box **step-ups**  
1 minute of push presses  
1 minute of rowing for calories  
Rest 1 minute

♀ **35**-lb barbell, **6**-lb medicine ball to a 9-foot target, and a **12**-inch box  
♂ **45**-lb barbell, **10**-lb medicine ball to a 10-foot target, and a 20-inch box
